HomeHero.welcomeLabel: Manaʻoʻiʻo a me ka Palapala Hemolele
HomeHero.welcomeTitle: Nā Wikiō i Koho ʻia no Kēia Lā
HomeHero.welcomeDescription: Nā wikiō i kau ʻia ma ka manaʻoʻiʻo mai kā mākou waihona, e hoʻoulu i ka naʻau, e hoʻoikaika, a e hoʻāla i ka noʻonoʻo ʻana.
HomeHero.morningTitle: Aloha kakahiaka! Ke kali nei nā manawa Baibala o kēia lā.
HomeHero.morningDescription: E hoʻomaka i kou lā me nā manawa Baibala hoʻoikaika e hoʻoulu a e hāpai i kou ʻuhane.
HomeHero.afternoonTitle: Aloha awakea! Nā manawa Baibala no kou lā.
HomeHero.afternoonDescription: Nā maʻiʻo Baibala hoʻoikaika, kūpono no kou manawa hoʻomaha awakea a i ʻole no ka hoʻoulu mau ʻana.
HomeHero.eveningTitle: Aloha ahiahi! E hoʻomaha me nā manawa Baibala.
HomeHero.eveningDescription: Nā manawa Baibala maluhia e kōkua iā ʻoe e noʻonoʻo a e loaʻa ka hōʻoluʻolu i ka pau ʻana o kou lā.
HomeHero.joinUsDescription: Ua hiki mai ka wā ʻohi. E hui pū me mākou i ka haʻi ʻana i ka ʻEuanelio i ke ao nei ma o nā pāpaho kikohoʻe.
HomeHero.togetherTitle: Ke haʻi pū nei i ka moʻolelo o Iesu
HomeHero.togetherDescription: I hiki iā lākou ke lohe a ʻike i ke aloha o Iesu ma ko lākou ʻōlelo ponoʻī, ma kahi o lākou e noho nei.
HomeHero.togetherAction: E komo pū i kā mākou mikiona

Mission.eyebrow: Kūkulu ʻia no nā mikiona honua
Mission.headline: ʻAʻole loli ka ʻōlelo. Loli ke ʻano o ka nānā ʻana o nā kānaka.
Mission.intro: Ke kūkulu hou nei mākou i kā mākou waihona wikiō a me nā mea paahana mai ke kumu mai, e lawe ana i nā makahiki he nui o ka hana unuhi i nā paepae kahi e ʻākoakoa, nānā, a kaʻana ai nā kānaka.
Mission.libraryPointTitle: ʻO ka waihona kiʻiʻoniʻoni i unuhi nui loa ʻia ma ka honua
Mission.libraryPointDescription: Ua kūkulu nā makahiki he nui o ka hana unuhi, i hāpai ʻia e nā hoa lawelawe hilinaʻi, i kahi waihona me nā tausani o nā ala ʻōlelo, i hiki i nā kānaka ke hālāwai me ka moʻolelo o Iesu ma ka ʻōlelo e pā loa ai i ko lākou naʻau.
Mission.formatsPointTitle: Ke lawe nei i nā leo hilinaʻi i nā ʻano hou
Mission.formatsPointDescription: Ke kūkulu hou nei mākou i ke ʻano o ka haʻi ʻana i nā moʻolelo ʻEuanelio ma ke kiʻi, me ka hoʻohui ʻana i nā unuhina hilinaʻi me nā ʻano hou i hiki i ka ʻōlelo ke holo kūʻokoʻa ma nā paepae, nā moʻomeheu, a me nā pale.
Mission.teamPointTitle: ʻOi aku ma mua o ka waihona. He hui i alakaʻi ʻia e ka mikiona.
Mission.teamPointDescription: He hui honua ʻo Jesus Film Project o nā mea unuhi, nā loea pāpaho, nā luna hoʻoponopono, a me nā mea haku, e hoʻololi ana i nā makahiki he nui o ka ʻike lawelawe i mau mea paahana no ka poʻe hoʻohaumāna ma nā wahi a pau.
Mission.highlightsHeading: Ka mea a mākou e kūkulu ai ma hope
Mission.nextStepsDescription: Hoʻopili i ka poʻe nānā me nā manawa maoli ma ko lākou huakaʻi ʻuhane, e kōkua ana iā lākou e hana i kahi ʻanuʻu aʻe i ke kaiāulu, ka Palapala Hemolele, a i ʻole ka mikiona.
Mission.mediaLibraryDescription: He waihona pāpaho Kalikiano nui me nā tausani o nā wikiō, nā kiʻiʻoniʻoni, a me nā punawai i loaʻa ma nā ʻōlelo he nui no ka lawelawe a me ka haʻi ʻEuanelio ma ka honua holoʻokoʻa.
Mission.ministryToolsTitle: Nā Mea Paahana Kikohoʻe no nā Lawelawe
Mission.ministryToolsDescription: Ka mālama wikiō, ka hāʻawi maʻiʻo, ka hoʻopili ʻana me ka poʻe nānā, a me ka ʻikepili, i hoʻolālā ʻia e kōkua i nā lawelawe e hiki aku i nā kānaka he nui aʻe me ka pono.
Mission.inviteHeadline: Kōkua i ke kūkulu ʻana i {accent} o nā mea paahana mikiona
Mission.inviteBody: Ke kono nei mākou i nā loea hana, nā mea haku, a me nā hoa hana i ka hoʻohana mua ʻana. E hoʻāʻo mua i nā mea paahana hou, e hāʻawi i kou manaʻo, a e kōkua i ka hoʻomōhala ʻana i nā huahana i hoʻolālā ʻia no ka hana mikiona maoli.
Mission.missionCardAriaHint: Wehe i ka ʻaoʻao mikiona o Jesus Film
Mission.roadmapCardAriaHint: Wehe i ka ʻaoʻao mikiona o Jesus Film ma ka māhele palapala ala
Mission.betaCardAriaHint: Wehe i ke kākau inoa beta ma kāu polokalamu kele pūnaewele
